root_cause: The GPTQ LLM export test for katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq has been failing since 2026-07-27 across 22 runs (21 prior + this one), affecting many different PRs. This is a recurring Code Issue in OpenVINO's handling of GPTQ-quantized OPT model export, showing a max numerical diff of ~0.069 exceeding the accuracy threshold. The docs-only PR #37079 is unrelated; the failure is a pre-existing regression in the GPTQ export path.
recommended_actions: Re-add PR #37079 to the merge queue as the failure is unrelated to the docs-only change
Investigate the accuracy threshold for GPTQ models - the 0.069 diff may require a looser tolerance for quantized models
Consider marking this test as flaky or adding a retry decorator
prevention_strategies: Set appropriate per-model accuracy thresholds for quantized/GPTQ models that account for expected quantization noise on CPU.
historical_context: This is occurrence #22 of a known Code Issue tracked since 2026-07-27. Prior occurrences affected PRs: #37079, #37071, #37020, #35116, #36894, #37029, #36957, #36860. 21 prior runs have shown the same failure.
